title: Meet Zhang Zhanshuo: The 19-year-old China swimmer who won record 7 Asian Games golds
summary_full: Zhang Zhanshuo, a young prodigy in the world of swimming, made an unforgettable mark at the 2026 Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya by clinching an astounding seven gold medals. He dominated the men's freestyle events, triumphing in the 200m, 400m, 800m, and 1,500m, alongside three relay victories. His exceptional performance not only set a new Asian Games record but also matched the highest number of individual golds.
